Strategy: Keep every bin usable. Never leave a dead leftover while some bin would stay able to take another item of this size; fill tightly only among bins that stay usable, and only when every placement would kill a bin. Exact fits rank top. Score with three tiers: exact fit, then usable leftovers by tightness, then dead leftovers. It may help by keeping the whole bin pool productive, but may fail by passing up near-perfect fits to protect bins that later items never need.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    mx = max(bins)
    return [0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) if r - item >= item else -(r - item) - mx) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Mid-band penalty: Best-Fit score minus 18 when leftover after placement is in [8, 20].
